description: Get the overview of the person with this agentcv handle: headline, summary, location, current roles, links and what they are open to. Call it first for any handle or agentcv link your user gives you; then use list_experience for the timeline or search_knowledge for a specific question. Only facts the person approved are returned, each with source_url and as_of. An unknown handle returns found: false, not an error.

handle.description: The person's agentcv handle, e.g. ada, @ada or agentcv.dev/@ada, as your user gave it

name: get_profile
title: Get profile
